encounter.intro: A lamp on a pole swings round and stops on your face, and the Lantern behind it goes very still in the particular way of a man comparing a face to a drawing he has looked at a great many times. "You," he says. "Hold there. Hands where I can see them." Around you the street discovers something urgent to do somewhere else.
